IOVA.trigger: Staged small long in the $12.20-$13.00 zone only after multiple sessions of stabilization with contracting volatility; restore normal sizing on weekly close above $15.30 on volume >40M or confirmed Q3 revenue reacceleration; deeper washout toward $10.99-11 is a second add zone
IOVA.entry_convention: small staged tranche post-stabilization; no chase into $15.30, no tactical short
IOVA.invalidation: Daily close below $14.10 opens fast move to ~$12.20; close below $12.78 invalidates the September repricing
IOVA.horizon: Primary decision point is Q3 earnings in early November; tactical reassessment at $12.20-$13.00
IOVA.reevaluation: Early-November Q3 print: sequential revenue above ~$99M restores the growth case; flat or down validates staying light
IOVA.ambiguity: Re-entry risk cap stated as 1.5-2% of portfolio in executive summary vs ~2.5-3% (~50% of standard dollar risk) in position sizing

MRNA.trigger: Resting short limit order near $200.50 inside the $200-209 resistance band; if price closes below $165 before fill, revisit short at better structure; if it rips through $215 unfilled, stand down entirely
MRNA.entry_convention: sell into strength via resting limit, not at market
MRNA.invalidation: Break above $215 removes defined risk — stand down; a verified catalyst for the August repricing abandons the short
MRNA.horizon: Up to 10 trading sessions (hard time stop); reassess at November Q3 print
MRNA.reevaluation: November Q3 print: ~$1B revenue would put a floor under the re-rating narrative
MRNA.ambiguity: Sizing conflict: ~65 shares / ~$950 risk (~1%) in executive summary vs ~130 shares / ~$2,000 (~2%) in position sizing

PBF.trigger: Staged limit buy in the $78-80 breakout-retest zone (first tranche ~3.5-4% of book); second tranche only on confirming crack-spread or Q3 margin data, not merely the retest holding

PBF.invalidation: Daily close below $78 = failed breakout (cut to minimal); close inside $70-77 base exits entirely; crack-spread compression or weak Q3 exits regardless of price

QMCO.trigger: Fresh evaluation only when price nears the $15-$20 consolidation shelf AND EDGAR verifies recapitalization/dilution terms AND a second consecutive quarter of positive operating income and operating cash flow is filed — evaluation gate, not automatic buy; no shorting

QMCO.invalidation: None — no position held; shorting explicitly rejected (recap mechanically succeeded, squeeze-prone)
QMCO.horizon: 3-6 months; re-evaluate after next quarterly filing
QMCO.reevaluation: Next quarterly filing: second positive operating quarter plus disclosed post-restructuring cap table terms
